evidence_refs.quote: Neo gives SecOps teams the inventory, posture intelligence, attribution, and policy control to manage enterprise-wide agentic transformation and secure AI agents, AI-enabled applications, browsers, identities, and traditional software with newly introduced agentic capabilities.

comparisons.name: Oasis Security
comparisons.scenario: 保护智能体和自动化服务使用的凭证和访问令牌
comparisons.core_difference: Oasis Security 专注于非人类身份治理，而 Neo 试图将清单、态势评估、归因和实时执行统一到一个覆盖智能体、应用程序、浏览器和传统软件的单一控制层中。

evidence_refs.quote: Oasis Security has focused specifically on non-human identity governance — securing the credentials and access tokens that agents and service accounts use, rather than the agents' behavior itself.
Neo is attempting to unify inventory, posture assessment, attribution and real-time enforcement into a single control layer spanning agents, applications, browsers and traditional software alike.

comparisons.name: WitnessAI

evidence_refs.quote: WitnessAI has positioned itself around AI usage governance and policy enforcement for generative AI tools broadly, with an emphasis on data loss prevention and compliance.
Neo enforces controls natively, enabling organizations to block risky activity, malicious models, and redirect out-of-bound prompts without handing enforcement off to another tool.

analysis.capital_judgment: 资本押注的核心变量是“智能体软件控制层”能否成为企业安全基础设施的独立品类。本轮1亿美元融资（种子轮和A轮合计）的估值基础并非来自已证实的规模化收入或产品成熟度，而是基于三个已验证信号：1）创始团队具备构建和规模化企业级安全平台的实战记录（SentinelOne 从100万美元到5亿美元 ARR 并完成 IPO）；2）企业应用智能体化的速度远超安全团队适应能力（Gartner 预测具备智能体能力的企业应用比例将从2025年的5%跃升至2026年底的40%）；3）现有安全架构无法覆盖智能体软件的非确定性行为，市场存在结构性空白。投资机构明确将 Neo 的创始团队背景作为品类定义能力的代理指标，而非依赖传统的产品市场匹配数据。
validated_signals: 创始团队曾将 SentinelOne 从100万美元 ARR 扩展至5亿美元并完成 IPO，具备构建和规模化企业级安全平台的实战记录
Gartner 数据显示具备智能体能力的企业应用比例预计从2025年的5%跃升至2026年底的40%，表明市场窗口正在快速打开
Neo 已开发出可在数分钟内生成组织完整智能体软件清单的扫描器，并建立了覆盖超过120万项技能、二进制文件、MCP 包和第三方 AI 模型的 Neoverse 知识库
Neo 的技术已在金融服务、交通运输和能源等受监管行业进行测试
risks: 智能体 AI 治理市场尚无行业共识，Neo 及其竞争对手和客户仍在共同定义该品类的完整产品形态，存在品类定义失败或偏离预期的风险
平台型安全厂商（如 CrowdStrike、Microsoft、Okta）可能将现有平台扩展至智能体治理领域，压缩独立厂商的生存窗口
Neo 的原生执行能力要求企业授予其自主阻断或重定向生产工作流的权限，企业对此类授权的谨慎态度可能导致部署深度停留在可观测性层面而非执行层面

Neo is attempting to unify inventory, posture assessment, attribution and real-time enforcement into a single control layer spanning agents, applications, browsers and traditional software alike.
WitnessAI has positioned itself around AI usage governance and policy enforcement for generative AI tools broadly, with an emphasis on data loss prevention and compliance.
Neo enforces controls natively, enabling organizations to block risky activity, malicious models, and redirect out-of-bound prompts without handing enforcement off to another tool.
Armadin, founded by Mandiant's creator, is leaning heavily on incident-response and threat-intelligence pedigree to build trust with security operations teams evaluating agentic risk.
